description: Compares take-home pay, income tax, employee social security, employer cost and the total tax wedge for the same gross salary in 20 countries under 2026 rules (single employee, no children, standard deductions): Spain, Portugal, France (Paris), Germany, Italy (Milan), Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, United Kingdom (England), Switzerland (Zurich), Sweden, Poland, United States (federal only), Canada (Ontario), Mexico (Mexico City), UAE, Singapore, Japan (Tokyo), Russia and China (Shanghai). Give the gross annual salary and its currency (EUR, USD, GBP, AED, CHF, CAD, SGD, JPY, CNY, MXN, SEK, PLN or RUB); it is converted at ECB reference rates of 20 Nov 2026. Set expat=true for a foreign professional (no CPF in Singapore, no UAE pension). Optionally limit to one country code. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/salary-tax-comparator/

country.description: Optional country code: es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, be, ie, uk, ch, se, pl, us, ca, mx, ae, sg, jp, ru, cn

name: salary_tax_comparator
title: Salary tax comparator (20 countries)
